cases.rationale: A visible person sits behind a pepperoni pizza on a rough wooden eating table. The blue-rimmed dish is a flat plate rather than a bowl. The upright metal cutting implement has overlapping handle and blade details that do not confidently distinguish a knife from scissors, so 43 and 76 are unclear. The horizontal wooden structure beside the person may be a bench, but is too cropped to establish its identity (13). Every definition was considered; the remaining categories have no identifiable corresponding object.

Human heads, arms and hands occupy the bottom edge; several small flying kites and their lines are visible in the sky. The winglike objects are kites rather than actual birds. A dark vertical support and fabric behind the foreground head may be part of a folding chair, but too little is visible to establish chair identity (56). All 75 definitions were considered; other categories have no identifiable instance.

Curved kite canopies fly over the sea and beach, where small upright human figures are visible. No actual bird, boat or identifiable surfboard is resolved. Sand, waves, vegetation and distant hills do not establish category objects. All 75 definitions were considered; no category ambiguity remains unresolved.

People surround prominent motorcycles with visible engines, headlights, handlebars and wheels. The woman at the right carries a maroon shoulder bag with a visible strap, supporting handbag rather than backpack. The visible vehicles are motorcycles; no pedal bicycle is identifiable. Clothing and helmets do not establish other accessories. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual man holds and operates a small mobile handset. His patterned neck garment is a scarf rather than a tie. The blurred building and street background supplies no other identifiable category object. All 75 definitions were considered; no category identity remains unresolved.

Two children sit at an eating table behind a large pizza on a flat metal pan; black dining chairs are visible behind them. The wooden-handled metal implement on the pan could be a knife or broad pizza server, with insufficient blade detail to settle knife identity (43). The pan is not a bowl. All 75 definitions were explicitly considered; the remaining categories lack identifiable instances.

A person uses one of two open laptops with integrated keyboards on an eating table set with plates and placemats. A remote lies at lower left; bound books are stacked at left and open at the bottom. A plant grows in a tan pot, and a white drinking mug sits behind the right laptop. The black foreground device is a tablet rather than an identifiable standalone monitor. Small background vessels leave bottle versus jug identity unresolved (39). Small obscured eating utensils do not show sufficient heads or blades to settle fork, knife or spoon identity (42, 43, 44). Topped breadlike food at the rear is unresolved between sandwich and pizza forms (48, 53). Every definition was considered; flat plates, papers and generic salad greens do not establish further categories.

A hamburger with filling between bread rests on an eating table beside a white ribbed food bowl and a handleless pint drinking glass. Dark dining chairs are visible behind. The tall frosted container has its opening cropped and is unresolved as bottle versus tall vessel (39). Reflective utensils on the rear plate are obscured and do not resolve fork, knife or spoon identities (42, 43, 44). Flat plates, lettuce and pickles do not establish additional vessel or listed produce categories. All 75 definitions were explicitly considered.

A white plush teddy bear with stuffed paws and muzzle sits at an open laptop. Toy construction excludes an actual bear or other real animal. The integrated keyboard, an external computer mouse and part of the wooden chair supporting the toy are visible. The surface is a computer desk, not an identifiable dining table; the screen belongs to the laptop rather than standalone TV. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A pale fire hydrant with a domed top and side outlets stands at left. Foreground newspaper vending cabinets are neither parking meters nor refrigerators; glowing overhead streetlamps are not traffic signals. Large white vehicle bodies behind the fence are too small and obstructed to confidently distinguish bus, rail vehicle or truck, leaving 5, 6 and 7 unclear. Printed objects on the cabinets do not count as actual depicted objects or books. All 75 definitions were considered.

People stand behind a food-laden eating table with a black chair at rear right. Bananas are recognizable on the right; carrot sticks and broccoli florets appear in the vegetable tray, with white open food bowls toward the back. Topped rectangular bread portions in the middle could be open sandwiches or pizza-like portions (48 and 53 unclear). Other visible cut fruit is grapes, melon and watermelon rather than an identifiable apple or orange. Beverage cans, wide-mouth condiment jars and printed food packaging do not establish bottles, cups or books. All 75 definitions were explicitly considered.

A tall giraffe with a long neck and patterned coat stands centrally in a fenced grassy enclosure. Smaller grazing animals at the upper right are too distant to resolve equid identity or stripes; horse and zebra remain plausible but uncertain (17, 22). The pale distant animal at the far left does not add a determinate listed species. Fences, posts, vegetation and distant structures do not identify other category objects. All 75 exact definitions were considered, including exclusions for other ungulates and unidentifiable animal parts.
